Marks every `BOOKED` appointment whose `windowEnd` plus the site's no-show grace has passed as `NO_SHOW`, each in its
own transaction, and answers the ids it marked. Naturally idempotent (a second run marks nothing new); driven by a
CronJob. Requires an `Idempotency-Key` like every POST. Publishes `DockAppointmentNoShow` per appointment.
